instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Digital lending platform offering point-of-sale consumer financing and SME working capital loans through an API-integrated credit decisioning engine. Underwritten €120M in loans across 40 merchant partners. Risk scoring combines traditional bureau data with open banking transaction analysis, allowing for real-time risk adjustments based on current cash flow metrics.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are our dominant strategic priorities. Our industry is experiencing margin compression due to rising input costs and price-sensitive customers. We need to systematically identify and eliminate inefficiencies across procurement, production, logistics, and back-office functions.
answers.additionalContext: The company relies heavily on manually reviewed credit applications, creating significant bottlenecks in the funding cycle that directly impact operational cost and customer wait times.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Automated Credit Application Triage Workflow
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a rules-based system to automate the initial screening and routing of loan applications will reduce manual review time by an estimated 30%. This incremental efficiency gain aligns perfectly with the primary goal of cost reduction and requires minimal upfront capital.

first_actions: Identify low-hanging fruit rules for automated rejection/approval.
Develop a lightweight Python script prototype for routing.
resources_needed: Time spent by founder on system setup
Existing data scientists' time for rule definition
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average manual review days from 4 to 2.5 within Q3.
milestones: Pilot deployment on one loan product (Month 3)

opportunities.title: Dynamic Pricing Engine Pilot for Working Capital
opportunities.rationale: Exploring the feasibility of a dynamic pricing model that adjusts loan interest rates in real-time based on predicted borrower risk and market liquidity. While high risk, a focused MVP test could unlock significant new revenue streams and improve portfolio yield.

first_actions: Define clear guardrails for rate adjustment (conservative approach).
Analyze current data pipeline capabilities to support real-time input.
Assemble a small external consulting sprint team.
resources_needed: Budget allocation of 1.5% of total budget for consulting/dev sprint
Access to specialized ML/risk modeling expertise (contract basis)
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful simulation run demonstrating a potential 2% increase in portfolio yield within the pilot scope.
milestones: Internal simulation and risk assessment review (Month 4)

next_steps.action: Conduct a full process mapping session focused solely on the loan origination pipeline.
Allocate and define scope for the Automated Credit Triage Pilot, securing necessary internal resource commitment.
Identify two external freelance/contract talent pools specializing in low-code automation tools (e.g., Zapier/Make or custom Python scripts) for the process optimization project.

key_weaknesses: Fragmented and manual innovation process limits scalability and speed.
Severe constraint on budget (3%) makes large, necessary infrastructure changes impossible.
Over-reliance on the founder for all technical decision-making leads to bottlenecking.
Low digital maturity requires significant foundational investment before advanced automation is feasible.
